steps.content: The phantoms of Langley and Nightingale are gone. But the thick mist shows no sign of letting up.

Access memories, concretize mental images, stoke up emotions... The nature of this dark illusory realm is the same as that of the healing amusement park created by the Hamel on the lake. Both are deep-level mental interference.
She's able to recreate the doubts in your subconscious so vividly. It seems she's reached deep into your psyche. She's bound to appear again.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Come out and face me. This kind of attack won't hurt me a bit.

steps.content: A familiar voice issues from the mist.
Aren't you... supposed to be powerful?
Then... how come you didn't save me?

steps.speaker: (Transition)
steps.content: (Gray-Haired Maiden's portrait fading in, with ruins in the background)
